user.title: Choose your Nexxtender
user.description: Pick the charger from the nearby Bluetooth devices, or type its MAC address (for example AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF). Many chargers don't advertise a name; you can find the address in Settings → Devices & services → Bluetooth → Advertisement monitor.

passkey.title: Pair with the Nexxtender
passkey.description: Enter the 6-digit Bluetooth PIN of charger {address}. Home Assistant will pair with it now, which can take up to a minute. Close the Nexxtmove app on your phone first: the charger accepts only one Bluetooth connection.{error_detail}

error.invalid_passkey: The charger asked for the PIN and then refused it.
error.pairing_failed: Pairing failed. Check the logs; the Bluetooth adapter must be a local adapter on the Home Assistant host (not a Bluetooth proxy).
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the charger. Make sure no phone is connected to it and try again.
error.not_in_range: Home Assistant does not currently see this device. Check the address and that the charger is in range.
error.invalid_address: This is not a valid Bluetooth MAC address.
error.pairing_interrupted: Pairing was interrupted: the Bluetooth connection dropped or timed out. This is usually a weak signal (below about -80 dBm). Move the adapter closer to the charger and try again.
error.passkey_not_requested: The charger refused pairing without asking for the PIN. Make sure no phone is connected to it, then try again.
error.auth_required: Pairing seemed to work, but the charger still refuses access. Try again; if it persists, send the logs.

abort.no_devices_found: No Nexxtender found over Bluetooth. Check that Bluetooth works in Home Assistant and that the charger is in range.
abort.not_in_range: The charger is not in range of a connectable Bluetooth adapter.
